## Documentation {#documentation}

### The Optics chapter {#optics-chapter}

- **The Optics chapter reads in order, from a first nested update to a PATCH** ([#1034](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/pull/1034), [#1038](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/pull/1038), [#1056](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/pull/1056), [#1086](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/pull/1086)). The sidebar starts with the pages a newcomer needs, then groups the rest by task. The examples follow one order service, the Mapping capstone's records, and every page keeps its address. See [Optics](../optics/ch_intro.md).
- **Find your field, then find your recipe** ([#1035](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/pull/1035), [#1045](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/pull/1045)). The Focus DSL page answers "what does my field give me?" with a table keyed by the field you hold. The Optics Cookbook opens on a "Find your recipe" table, each recipe leading with a Focus path. See [Find your field](../optics/focus_dsl.md#find-your-field) and [Find your recipe](../optics/cookbook.md#find-your-recipe).
- **The first lane ends in a capstone and a self-check** ([#1036](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/pull/1036), [#1039](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/pull/1039), [#1041](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/pull/1041)). What a Path Is Made Of, Updates That Can Fail and Many Edits at Once are rewritten. Six pages pause for checkpoints the build proves, a capstone builds an order desk, and two new tutorials practise them. See [Check Your Understanding](../optics/self_check.md).
- **Two lookup pages translate what you already write into optics** ([#1046](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/pull/1046)). Coming from Lombok, Streams and Switch sets each wither, stream and `switch` habit beside its path, and says when plain Java wins. Coming from Monocle or Haskell maps their names, and the six behaviours that differ. See [Look It Up](../optics/ch7_intro.md).
- **Compositions read as Java, and two hard rules come with a story** ([#1037](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/pull/1037), [#1040](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/pull/1040)). The chapter and the `hkj-optics` skill write `Lens.andThen(Prism) = Affine` instead of `>>>`. Composition Rules opens on a short dialogue, and the Lenses page tells how a constructor that lowercases an email quietly breaks a lens. See [Optic Composition Rules](../optics/composition_rules.md).
- **Every diagram draws each optic in one shape** ([#1044](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/pull/1044), [#1049](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/pull/1049), [#1055](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/pull/1055)). A legend on the introduction gives every optic type its own shape, and every diagram fits a phone's screen and describes itself to a screen reader. Each deeper page opens with what you will be able to do ([#1042](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/pull/1042)). See [How the optic types relate](../optics/ch_intro.md#how-the-optic-types-relate).
- **Production Readiness opens on ten questions and holds the cost facts** ([#1043](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/pull/1043), [#1050](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/pull/1050)). The questions run from what a lens update allocates to whether generated classes stay stable across versions. Each optic's allocations and reads are stated in one place, naming the method behind each fact. See [Production Readiness](../optics/production_readiness.md).
- **Every example is compiled, and every name keeps one shape** ([#1020](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/pull/1020), [#1047](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/pull/1047), [#1048](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/pull/1048), [#1101](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/pull/1101), [#1114](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/pull/1114), [#1119](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/pull/1119), [#1120](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/pull/1120)). A test holds each value the Optics pages state. A type name such as `Order` means one thing across the Optics and Mapping chapters, the skills and the annotations' javadoc. See [Affines](../optics/affine.md).

### Glossary and reference pages {#glossary-and-reference}

- **The Effect Paths glossary gains nine entries** ([#1143](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1143), [#1237](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1237), [#1245](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1245), [#1264](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1264)): `CompletableFuturePath`, `EitherOrBothPath`, `EitherPath`, `IdPath`, `IOPath`, `LazyPath`, `MaybePath`, `OptionalPath` and `VTaskPath`. Each gives a definition and its factories on `Path`, and four list their main operations. See [Effect Paths](../glossary/effect-paths.md#completablefuturepath).
- **The glossary gains entries across type classes, optics and concurrency** ([#1037](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/pull/1037), [#1184](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1184), [#1226](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1226), [#1227](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1227), [#1235](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1235)). The type classes gain `Alternative`, `Foldable`, `MonadZero` and `Traverse`, the optics `Getter`, `Ixed` and `Each`, and the core effect types `Reader`, `State` and `Writer`. Concurrency gains `Retry` and `Saga`, and the optics list `andThen`, `modifyF` and path widening. See [Type Classes](../glossary/type-classes.md).
- **Glossary entries name methods their types have** ([#1155](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1155), [#1225](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1225)): `getOptional` and `build` for a `Prism`, `getAll` and `preview` for a `Fold`, and `asFold().getAll(source)` for a `Traversal`. The check that compiles the book's examples now counts every error, where it skipped any that mentioned "preview". See [Prism](../glossary/optics.md#prism).
- **The cheat sheet and the Type Conversions tables match the code** ([#1142](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1142), [#1170](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1170), [#1171](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1171), [#1221](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1221)). The Path Types table gains `FreeApPath` and `VStreamPath`, and names the methods that extract a `LazyPath`, a `GenericPath` and a `WithStatePath`. Two conversion rows give the function `toTryPath` and `toIdPath` take. See [Path Types](../cheatsheet.md#path-types).
- **The Capability Interfaces page matches the interfaces** ([#1182](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1182)): `OptionalPath` is only `Chainable` and falls back with `orElsePath`, Combinable lists `zipWith`, and Effectful names `guarantee`. See [Capability Interfaces](../effect/capabilities.md).
- **`WriterT` joins the transformer overview** ([#1195](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1195)): the overview, its Path table and Supported Types now list all six transformers. See [WriterT](../transformers/transformers.md#writert-accumulating-output-across-effect-boundaries).
- **The `hkj-test` page lists every assertion class** ([#1193](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1193)): `EitherOrBothAssert`, `NonEmptyListAssert`, `FieldErrorAssert` and the Kind-narrowing wrappers join its table, in the book and in the module's README. See [What Is Covered](../tooling/test_assertions.md#what-is-covered).
- **`StandardCodecs.locale()` says a variant keeps its case** ([#1202](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1202)): `sl-rozaj` and `sl-ROZAJ` both round-trip, as two different locales, while a case-folded language, region or private-use subtag is still refused. See [Standard codecs](../mapping/codecs.md#standard-codecs).
- **The contributing guide clones your own fork, and lists every module** ([#1194](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1194)): its first steps now clone your fork, so the later push reaches it, and the module list includes `hkj-bom` and `hkj-test`. See [Contributing](../CONTRIBUTING.md).

### Other pages {#other-pages}

- **`@PathSource` has a page of its own** ([#999](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/999)): [Custom Paths with `@PathSource`](../effect/path_source.md) says when a generated Path is worth it over `GenericPath`, what each capability generates, and how `errorType` types recovery.
- **The Resource page gives the order finalisers run in** ([#1019](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1019)): the order they were added, where it said the reverse. It also says which exception is reported when a release and a finaliser both throw. See [Finaliser Behaviour](../monads/vtask_resource.md#finalizer-behaviour).
- **`modifyAllEither` says it keeps the first error, not that it stops there** ([#1031](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/pull/1031)): every focused value is still validated, and the result keeps the first error in traversal order. The javadoc and the examples now say so too. See [`modifyAllEither`: First Error Only](../optics/optics_extensions.md#modifyalleither-first-error-only).
- **`maxNavigatorDepth` says what it does** ([#1030](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1030)). A value of `1` makes a navigator's own navigation methods return plain paths, and a larger value, the default included, ends no chain. Its javadoc and Tutorial 19 now say so. See [Controlling navigator generation](../optics/focus_navigation.md#controlling-navigator-generation).
- **The Focus pages say what a wildcard inside a container's element gives you** ([#813](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/813)). A `List<Box<? extends Widget>>` widens to a `TraversalPath` over `Box<? extends Widget>`, wildcard kept. `BoxFocus.value()` needs a named type argument, so the page shows the lens to write instead. See [A wildcard inside the element](../optics/focus_containers.md#a-wildcard-inside-the-element).
- **Javadoc examples name monoids that exist** ([#1056](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/pull/1056)): `Fold`, `IndexedFold`, `TraversalPath`, `ConstApplicative` and the Focus package overview show `Monoids.integerAddition()` and its siblings, where they named `Monoids.intSum()` and `Monoid.of`.
- **Every chapter's Previous and Next links follow its contents** ([#1086](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/pull/1086), [#1093](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/pull/1093)). Ninety-five pages across eight chapters had stale or missing links, several skipping a page added since. The book check now finds every chapter itself, so a new one is held to its contents too.

---

## Upgrading from 0.4.11 {#upgrading}

Many changes stop the build, most with a message that names the fix. Read [Before you upgrade](#before-you-upgrade) first, then [What a running program can notice](#runtime-changes), which lists the changes the compiler cannot point at.

### Before you upgrade {#before-you-upgrade}

- **Run `MigrateDeprecationsTo0_5_0` before you move to 0.5.0** ([#445](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/445), [#452](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/452), [#1260](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1260), [#1262](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1262)): take `hkj-openrewrite` 0.5.0 for the run, and keep the project on 0.4.11 until it finishes. Its recipes find every removed API only on 0.4.x. Rename each element field its `widenFields` recipe ([#1106](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1106)) marks before you move, so the compiler finds the calls through it. See [0.5.0 deprecation migration](../tooling/openrewrite.md#050-deprecation-migration).
- **Under `-Werror`, run `MigrateDeprecationsTo0_6_0` in the same pass** ([#1105](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1105)): on 0.5.0 a call to a deprecated Focus path shortcut fails a `-Werror` build. Every typed form the recipe writes is in 0.4.11, so it can run beside `MigrateDeprecationsTo0_5_0`. Replace by hand each call it marks.
- **Replace `Void` with `Unit` where a success has nothing to return** ([#1065](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1065), [#1078](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1078)): `Either<E, Void>` and `Try<Void>` can no longer hold their null. A `VTask<Void>`, `IOPath<Void>` or other lazy computation fails when its step returns null. `VTask.exec`, `Path.vtaskExec` and `Path.ioRunnable` give `Unit`. The `MigrateDeprecationsTo0_5_0` run marks each site.
- **Recompile what was compiled against a generated Focus class** ([#1033](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1033), [#1214](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1214)): a field or a hop that gains a navigator returns a navigator class. A module compiled against the earlier class fails with `NoSuchMethodError` until it is rebuilt.
- **Recompile what calls `chunk`, `chunkWhile`, `mapChunked` or `SagaBuilder.start()`** ([#580](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/580)): `start()` returns a new type, so a module compiled against 0.4.11 fails with `NoSuchMethodError`. A chunk keeps its erased type, so such a module links, then fails with `ClassCastException` where it reads a chunk as a `List`.

### What a running program can notice {#runtime-changes}

#### Mapping {#runtime-mapping}

- **A date codec over a formatter that cannot parse what it writes throws when built** ([#1144](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1144)): `StandardCodecs.localDate(formatter)` and `offsetDateTime(formatter)` throw `IllegalArgumentException`, with the formatter's `DateTimeException` as its cause. Such a codec used to be built, then refuse every input.
- **A bean property is read through its accessor, never a word declared before it** ([#1128](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1128)): a `getaway()` or `island()` declared before `getAway()` or `isLand()` read `away` or `land`, and the accessor now does.
- **A merge fill can parse through a generic spec in this compilation** ([#1123](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1123)): a dependency's spec for exactly the pair used to fill it. It now resolves as a mapping's nest does, your own specs first. A leaf named after the component, delegating to the dependency's Impl, keeps the old fill.

#### Optics {#runtime-optics}

- **A `@GenerateFocus` record field, or a container of one, returns a navigator** ([#1033](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1033), [#1103](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1103), [#1214](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1214)): a `getClass()` check sees the navigator class, as it does the form a hop from a wider navigator returns. A navigator equals only a navigator of the same class over an equal path, never the plain path it wraps.
- **A navigator is a path** ([#1033](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1033)): one from a record that wrote `generateNavigators = true` passes `instanceof FocusPath`, and an overload taking a `FocusPath` is chosen over one taking `Object`.
- **A 0.4.x navigation call can compile against a path method instead** ([#1033](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1033), [#1106](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1106), [#1243](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1243)): take a record that writes `generateNavigators = true`, with a `Map` field `byTicker` of records with a `last` field. `byTicker().last()` then calls the path's own `last()`, which throws `ClassCastException`. A note at the field and `MigrateDeprecationsTo0_5_0` ask for `last` to be renamed before you move. See [Compiler Messages](../optics/compiler_errors.md#generatefocus-no-navigator-over-elements).
- **A null `@Nullable` container has no focus** ([#1062](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1062)): a generated Focus path that steps into one reads nothing, and a modification leaves it null, where both threw `NullPointerException`.
- **A read through an `Optional` or a `Maybe` reads a null focus as absent** ([#767](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/767)): `Fold.preview`, `TraversalPath.preview` and `toMaybePath`, and `FocusPath.toMaybePath` used to throw `NullPointerException`. So did `FocusPath.asAffine`, `headOption`, `IxedInstances.get` and the list optics `listAt`, `listHead` and `listLast`, whose setters, and the list prisms' `build`, now write a null.
- **Other optics carry a null focus through** ([#767](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/767)): `find` passes over a null focus to the next match, where it threw. `Setter.forList`, and `FocusPaths.listElements`, `arrayElements`, `listCons`, `listSnoc`, `listTail`, `listInit` and `mapValues`, carry a null element. `IxedInstances.contains` counts an index holding a null as present, and `Plans.preflight` walks a batched traversal to the end, so `truncated` is now `false`.
- **A traversal's Effect Path bridges leave a null focus out** ([#1017](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1017)): `toStreamPath`, `toVStreamPath` and `VStreamPath.fromEach` used to stream it, and `toListPath` and `toNonDetPath` threw `NullPointerException`. `TraversalPath.fold` counts it as the monoid's empty value, where `Monoids.string()` appended `"null"`. `getAll` still keeps every focus.
- **A raw `modifyF` under `Either` or `Try` cannot pass over a null element** ([#1065](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1065)): `filtered` keeps an element it passes over by lifting it with `of`, as do a prism and an affine that miss. Under those applicatives `of` now refuses null. `TraversalExtensions.modifyAllEither` and its siblings keep the element.
- **`OpticPrograms.get` fails on a null focus, naming `preview`** ([#1078](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1078)): a Free program always gives a value, so the direct and logging interpreters throw `NullPointerException`, and `ValidationOpticInterpreter` records an error. `StateOps.view` on a null focus fails the same way.
- **A map an optic writes iterates in the source's order** ([#1022](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/pull/1022)): it came back in hash order, so printed output or a test of a map's iteration order can change. `FocusPaths.mapValues` over an empty map returns a new map.
- **A `TreeMap` keeps its order but not its type** ([#1022](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/pull/1022)): `forMapValuesCollecting(TreeMap::new)` keeps both when the keys sort in their natural order. A `TreeMap` with its own comparator needs a collector that builds the new `TreeMap` with that comparator.
- **The function a predicate does not pick is no longer called** ([#1026](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/pull/1026)): by `modifyWhen` and `branch` on a `Traversal`, and by `modifyWhen` and `modifyBranch` on a `Lens`. `Lens.setIf` no longer calls `set` on a failed predicate. `Traversals.speculativeTraverseList` is unchanged: it applies both functions to every element.
- **A query's predicate is not called after its answer** ([#1056](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/pull/1056)): `find`, `exists` and `all`, on `Fold`, `IndexedFold` and `TraversalPath`, stop at the focus that settles them, so a logging or counting predicate sees fewer calls. A `Fold` of your own whose `foldMap` catches every exception still gives the same answer, but walks on to its end.
- **A read no longer runs a traversal's rebuild** ([#1056](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/pull/1056)): a `Traversal` of your own whose rebuild logs or counts no longer runs it for `Traversals.getAll`, a `TraversalPath`'s reads, `IndexedTraversals.toIndexedList`, `getAll` and `length`, or `asIndexedFold()`.
- **`OptionalTraverse.traverse` rejects a function that returns null** ([#1056](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/pull/1056)). For a present value, a `null` from the function used to give an empty `Optional`. It now throws `NullPointerException`, as the other `Traverse` instances do.
- **Sequenced lists are unmodifiable at every size** ([#1018](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1018)): `IndexedTraversals.sequenceList`, `ForTraversal.toList` and `ForIndexed.toIndexedList` now return one, as `Traversals.traverseList` does. So do `IndexedTraversals.forList` on a non-empty list and `Traversals.traverseArray` on an empty array. Copy the result into a new `ArrayList` to change it.
- **`ForTraversal.toList` and `ForIndexed.toIndexedList` honour the filters** ([#1018](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1018)): they collect only the elements that pass `filter` and `filterIndex`, as `modify` and `set` already did. They used to return every focused element. See [Collecting Results](../functional/for_optics.md#collecting-results).
- **The list optics that returned an `ArrayList` now return an unmodifiable list** ([#1063](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1063)): `.each()`, `.at(i)`, `.head()` and `.last()` on a Focus path, `ListTraversals`, `AtInstances.listAt` and `listAtWithPadding`, and `IxedInstances.listIx`. Changing one throws `UnsupportedOperationException`, so copy it first. With nothing at the index, `.at(i)` and `listIx` return your own list. See [What each collection optic builds](../optics/production_readiness.md#collection-optics).
- **A Focus path over a field declared as `ArrayList` fails when `.each()`, `.at(i)`, `.head()` or `.last()` writes** ([#1063](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1063)): storing the rebuilt list, an unmodifiable `List`, back throws `ClassCastException`. `.each()` already failed on a one-element list. Declare the field as `List`, or use `each(EachInstances.fromIterableCollecting(ArrayList::new))`.
- **A `@ViaConstructor` lens with no `parameterOrder` sets through its constructor** ([#906](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/906)): the order is read from the constructor's parameter names, where `set` used to throw `UnsupportedOperationException`.
- **A spec lens whose focus is wider than its getter's wrapper passes the value as it is** ([#906](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/906)): with `Number` over an `int` getter, it used to be cast to `int` for `withX(int)`. Where the wither, setter or constructor is also overloaded for a wider type, such as `withX(Object)`, that overload is now the one called.
- **A `@ViaCopyAndSet` lens over a `withX` setter hands back what it returns** ([#1108](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1108), [#1128](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1128)): not the copy, where every method of that name the new value can be passed to returns the source type. A fluent `withX` behaves as before, and so does every `set` method. A `witheMail`, as JavaBeans spells one for `eMail`, is a `withX` setter too.
- **A `@ViaBuilder` lens over a Lombok `@Singular` collection, or through a protobuf-java message's `addAllTags` or `putAllPoints`, replaces the collection** ([#1110](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1110)): `set` used to add the new elements to the ones `toBuilder()` copied. Code that set a one-element list to add an element now keeps only that element; append with `modify` instead.
- **An `Each` of your own that declares `eachWithIndex()` without `@Override` is no longer indexed** ([#1261](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1261)): it still compiles, as a method of its own, but `supportsIndexed()` now returns false for it. Implement `EachIndexed` instead.

#### Effect Paths: null values {#runtime-effect-paths}

- **A null success throws, or fails a `Try`** ([#1065](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1065)): `Either.right(null)`, `Try.success(null)` and the Path factories throw `NullPointerException`, and so does an `Either` or `EitherPath` `map` whose function returns null. In `Try.of`, `map`, `ap`, `recover` and `TryPath`, a null result gives a `Failure` holding one. A `VResultPath` fails when it runs.
- **A null error throws** ([#1077](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1077)): `Either.left(null)`, `EitherT.left`, `raiseError(null)` on `EitherMonad` and `EitherTMonad`, and a `mapLeft` or `bimap` whose error function returns null throw `NullPointerException`, where they built `Left(null)`.
- **`raiseError(null)` throws on `Maybe`, `Optional`, `MaybeT` and `OptionalT`** ([#1078](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1078)): it gave `Nothing` or an empty `Optional`. Pass `Unit.INSTANCE`. Every `MonadError` now refuses a null error.
- **`recover(ma, null)` throws on `EitherMonad`, `TryMonad` and `EitherTMonad`** ([#1065](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1065)): whether or not `ma` failed. A null fallback used to give `Right(null)` or `Success(null)`. `Try.orElseGet` refuses a supplier that returns null, as `Validated.orElseGet` does; `orElse(null)` still hands a null back.
- **The conversions into an `Either` check their error even when it is not needed** ([#1077](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1077)): `Maybe.toEither` checks its error, or its supplier, even on a `Just`. The optics helpers `getEither`, `getValidated`, `modifyEither` and `modifyValidated` check theirs even when the focus is there. `Try.toEither` throws `NullPointerException` for a mapper that returns null, where it threw `KindUnwrapException`.
- **The one-argument `toEitherPath` and `toTryPath` on a `FocusPath` throw on a null focus** ([#1065](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1065)): they gave `Right(null)` and `Success(null)`. The message names the form that takes an error. `EitherPath.focus(FocusPath)` throws on a null focus too, naming `focus(path.nullable(), …)`, and `TryPath.focus` gives a `Failure`.
- **`ErrorContext.io` treats a null result as a failure** ([#1065](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1065)): its error mapper sees a `NullPointerException`, where the context held `Right(null)`.
- **A function that returns null fails the computation** ([#1065](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1065), [#1078](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1078)): a callable, supplier, `map` function, combiner or recovery function that returns null fails the lazy computation when it runs, and the `NullPointerException` names that function. So `VTask.of(() -> { work(); return null; })` fails, where `run()` handed the null back.
- **A null result fails where a computation becomes a `Try` or an `Either`** ([#1065](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1065)): `runSafe`, `toTryPath`, `asTry`, `Scope.joinSafe` and `EffectBoundary.runSafe` give a `Failure` holding a `NullPointerException`. `joinEither` and `FreePath.attempt` give a `Left`, and `catching` hands it to its mapper.
- **A null value passed to a lazy factory throws** ([#1078](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1078)): `VTask.succeed`, `State.pure`, `Reader.constant`, `Writer.value`, `Lazy.now`, `Trampoline.done`, `Free.pure`, `FreeAp.pure`, `VStream.of`, `Context.succeed`, the Path factories such as `Path.ioPure` and `Path.id`, and `of` on their monads throw `NullPointerException`. So do the constructors of `StateTuple`, `Writer`, `Trampoline.Done`, `Free.Pure` and `VStream`'s `Emit` and `Seed`.
- **`StateT`, `ReaderT` and `WriterT` refuse a null value** ([#1078](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1078)): `of` on their monads, `WriterT.of` and `WriterT.writer` throw on one. A function given to `ReaderT.reader`, or to `map` or `ap` on their monads, that returns null fails the computation. `ReaderTMonad.of(null)` over `Optional` gave an empty `Optional`.
- **`VTask.run()` and `runAsync()` refuse a null from a hand-written task** ([#1078](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1078)): a `VTask` written as a lambda that returns null throws `NullPointerException` from `run()`, and fails the future from `runAsync()`. `PathOps.firstVTaskSuccess` counts such a null as a failure and tries the next path. `VTaskContext.runOrElse` refuses a null default, and `runOrElseGet` a handler that returns null.
- **An `IOPath`, `Par` and a `Scope` refuse a null from a hand-written `IO` or task** ([#1078](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1078)): `IOPath.unsafeRun()` throws `NullPointerException` for one, as does each step that runs it, and `EffectBoundary.embed`. `Par`'s combinators and a `Scope` that needs every subtask fail on such a null, and an accumulating `Scope` records it as an error.
- **A stream refuses a null element** ([#1078](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1078)): `VStream.of` throws on one, and `fromList`, `fromIterator`, `fromStream` and `generate` fail the stream when they pull one. `fromPublisher` cancels its subscription and fails the stream. `StreamPath` does the same for its sources. `PathOps.traverseVStream` still hands a null item in its list to the function.
- **A `CompletableFuturePath` fails on a future that completes with null** ([#1078](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1078), [#1072](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1072)): `Path.future` and `fromFuture` check the value as it arrives: map a `runAsync` future to `Unit` first. Cancelling either future cancels both. `withTimeout` and `completeOnTimeout` complete only the new path's future, and the latter refuses a null default. `CompletableFutureMonad` keeps the JDK's null.
- **An `IdPath` always holds a value** ([#1078](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1078)): `Path.id(null)` throws, as does `Path.idPath` given an `Id` holding null. `FocusPath.toIdPath` throws on a null focus, naming `toMaybePath`, and so does `IdPath.focus`, naming `focus(path.nullable())`. `Id` and `IdMonad` still hold a null, since every optic's `modify` runs through them.
- **The lazy Paths' `focus` refuses a null focus** ([#1078](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1078)): `IOPath`, `VTaskPath` and `VStreamPath` fail when they run, and the message names the `path.nullable()` form to use. They used to hold the null.
- **`Context.ask` fails on a key bound to null** ([#1078](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1078)): read a key that may hold null with `asks`. `SecurityContext.requireAuthenticated` still fails an anonymous user with `UnauthenticatedException`.
- **A null in a saga fails its step** ([#1065](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1065), [#1078](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1078)): a step whose task returns null fails like any other step, and so does a `map` that returns null. The steps before it are compensated, under `Saga.run` and `Saga.runSafe` alike. A null result gave `Right(null)` from `runSafe`, and `run` handed it back.
- **A null result from a deferred trampoline step names its supplier** ([#1153](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1153), [#1161](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1161)). It is still a `NullPointerException`, raised when the step runs: from `run()` for `Trampoline.defer`, and from the deferred step for `TrampolinePath.defer` and `Path.trampolineDefer`. No call site needs to change.

#### Effect Paths: resources, cancellation and streams {#runtime-resources}

- **A finaliser that used to be skipped now runs** ([#1024](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1024)): when a `VStream` stops early, a terminal operation fails, or a function given to an operator such as `map`, `filter` or `mapTask` throws. A finaliser that throws then fails the operation that stopped, such as `take` or `headOption`. Closing runs the innermost finaliser first, as completing does.
- **A `bracket` whose `use` function throws releases the resource** ([#1024](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1024)): before the failure reaches the caller. It used to leave the resource acquired.
- **Closing a pulled `bracket` stream releases its latest run** ([#1024](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1024)): closing the head of a `bracket` after a pull releases the resource that pull acquired, where it used to release nothing.
- **`onFinalize` runs its finaliser for each consumption of a `VStream`** ([#1018](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1018)): a second consumption, or one after `close()`, used to skip it. It now also runs when the source fails as it is pulled. `close()` runs it for the latest consumption only, unless that consumption has run it already. See [onFinalize: Lightweight Cleanup](../monads/vstream_resources.md#onfinalize-lightweight-cleanup).
- **`VStream.defer` calls its supplier when the pulled `VTask` runs** ([#1024](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1024)): not when `pull()` is called, and again on each run. `generate`, `iterate` and `unfold` call their functions then too. `distinct`, `chunk` and `chunkWhile` now give the same step each time a pulled `VTask` runs, and a `distinct` tail pulled again replays its elements.
- **`VStreamPar.parEvalMap`, `parEvalMapUnordered` and the `VStream` applicative's `ap` read their input when the pulled `VTask` runs** ([#1024](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1024)): not when `pull()` is called, and afresh on each run.
- **`VStreamPar.merge` starts a producer for each run of its pulled `VTask`** ([#1024](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1024), [#1073](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1073)): not when `pull()` is called. Closing it stops that run's producer and waits for each unfinished source to close, even with an interrupt pending. `close()` now stops the producer when its `VTask` runs, not when it is called. See [merge: Concurrent Multi-Source Consumption](../monads/vstream_parallel.md#merge-concurrent-multi-source-consumption).
- **Cancelling a `toPublisher` subscription runs the stream's finalisers** ([#1024](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1024)): once the subscriber has requested elements. It used to leave the stream open.
- **`VStreamThrottle.throttle` gives each consumption its own window** ([#1018](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1018)): each consumption's first emission opens its first window. A later or concurrent consumption used to share the first one's window.
- **`Resource.onFailure` runs its action when the use fails** ([#1019](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1019)): it used to do nothing. The action runs before the release, both when the use fails and when a step composed after it fails while the resource is held, such as `map`'s function throwing. See [onFailure Callback](../monads/vtask_resource.md#onfailure-callback).
- **`Resource.map` releases the resource when its function throws** ([#1019](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1019)): it used to leave the resource acquired.
- **A `Resource` rejects a null value** ([#1019](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1019)): an `acquire` given to `make` or `fromAutoCloseable` that returns null, a null passed to `pure`, and a function given to `map` that returns null now fail with `NullPointerException`. Hold an absent value as a `Maybe` instead. See [Factory Methods](../monads/vtask_resource.md#factory-methods).
- **A failing use keeps its own exception when cleanup fails too** ([#1019](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1019), [#1053](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1053)): in a `Resource`, and in `IOPath.bracket`, `bracketIO`, `guarantee`, `guaranteeIO` and `VTaskPath.guarantee`, the cleanup's exception is kept among the use's suppressed exceptions. When a release and a finaliser both throw, the release's exception is reported. See [Exception Safety](../monads/vtask_resource.md#exception-safety).
- **`and(second, third)` releases its first resource when two releases throw one exception** ([#1019](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1019)): the same exception instance from both used to fail with `IllegalArgumentException` and leave the first resource acquired.
- **An exception from `close()` fails `withResource`, `withResourceIO` and `fromAutoCloseable`** ([#1053](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1053)): it used to be dropped. After a successful use, `IOPath` throws it unchecked, a `SQLException` as the cause of a `RuntimeException`, and the task from `Resource.use` fails. After a failed use, it is suppressed onto the use's. To ignore it, pass `bracket` or `Resource.make` a release that catches it.
- **`withResource` and `withResourceIO` reject a null resource** ([#1053](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1053)): a resource supplier that returns null now fails with `NullPointerException` before the use runs. The use used to receive the null. Check for an absent resource before building the path.
- **Cleanup runs with the interrupt status cleared** ([#1019](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1019), [#1053](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1053), [#1057](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1057), [#1073](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1073)): after any use, in `Resource`, `IOPath`, `VTaskPath`, `VStream` finalisers, `bracketOutcome` and each `Saga` compensation. So a blocking close is not cut short, and a `Scope` that timed out during the use waits for it. The status is restored afterwards, and `withResource` sets it when `close()` throws an `InterruptedException`.
- **A cancelled `bracketOutcome` use leaves the thread interrupted** ([#1057](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1057)): when the use throws an `InterruptedException`, the interrupt status is set again once the release has run. The thread's next blocking call then throws `InterruptedException` at once. To tell a cancellation from other failures, map `InterruptedException` to its own error in `onDefect`.
- **A task's checked exception passes through `Retry`, `Bulkhead` and `protectWithFallback` unwrapped** ([#1072](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1072)): `Bulkhead.protect`, `Retry.retryTask` and its fallback and recovery forms, and `withBulkhead` and `withRetry` on `VTaskPath` and `VResultPath`, wrapped it in `VTaskExecutionException`. `CircuitBreaker.protectWithFallback` wrapped it, and an `Error`, in `RuntimeException`. A `retryOn` predicate, a fallback and `RetryExhaustedException.getCause()` now see the exception itself.
- **An interrupt stops a retry** ([#1072](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1072)): an attempt that throws `InterruptedException` is not tried again, whatever the predicate, and the exception passes through as thrown, past any fallback. A thread left interrupted between attempts stops the retry with its status set and `RetryExhaustedException`, which a fallback still handles. A recovery task does not start after either.
- **A timeout passes a cancellation on** ([#1072](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1072)): when a thread waiting on `VTask.timeout` is interrupted, so is the task, and `InterruptedException` follows once it stops or the time runs out. It used to leave the task running and report its result or a `TimeoutException`. `withTimeout` on `VTaskPath`, `IOPath`, `VResultPath` and `EitherPath` builds on it.
- **A cancelled call trips no circuit breaker and skips a `ResilienceBuilder` fallback** ([#1072](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1072)): a call that throws `InterruptedException` counts as neither a success nor a failure, whatever `recordFailure` says. The fallback lets it pass.
- **`VTask.run()`, `runSafe()` and `Try.attempt` keep a cancellation's interrupt status** ([#1072](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1072)): each sets it again for an `InterruptedException` it wraps or returns as the failure, and the Path forms built on them follow. So a retry around `IOPath.withTimeout` sees the cancellation and stops, and the thread's next blocking call throws at once. The status used to be cleared.
- **An extremely long duration no longer throws** ([#1072](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1072)): a duration too long to count in nanoseconds, such as `ChronoUnit.FOREVER.getDuration()`, counts as about 292 years in timeouts, waits, retry delays, throttle windows and `retryAfter`. Some of those threw `ArithmeticException`. Sub-millisecond parts are kept, where `RetryPolicy` and several waits dropped them.
- **`Scope.firstComplete` and `ScopeJoiner.firstComplete()` cancel the other subtasks once one completes** ([#1052](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1052)): they used to wait for every subtask. Those still running are interrupted and those not yet started never start, so work a slower subtask does afterwards, such as writing a cache, no longer happens. Move work that must finish out of the race.
- **`ScopeJoiner.joiner()` returns a new `Joiner` on each call** ([#1052](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1052)): code that opened a scope with one call and read `result()` from another now reads a `Joiner` no scope has used. That gives an empty result or an exception, so use the value the scope's `join()` returns.
- **A `Scope`'s timeout cancels its subtasks** ([#1052](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1052)): when it expires, those still running are interrupted, and the run fails with a `TimeoutException` once they have stopped. So a subtask that ignores interrupts now delays the failure. Its subtasks now see the caller's `ScopedValue` bindings, which they used to find unbound.
- **An interrupt while a timed `Scope` waits fails the run** ([#1052](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1052)): with an `InterruptedException`, as it does for an untimed `Scope`. A timed one used to ignore it and keep waiting.
- **`Par` and `PathOps` copy the list they are given when called** ([#1052](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1052)): `Par.race`, `all` and `traverse`, and `PathOps.sequenceVTask`, `traverseVTask`, `firstVTaskSuccess`, `parSequenceIO` and `raceIO`. Changing the list afterwards no longer changes what a run does. A null task or path in a list, or in `Scope.forkAll`'s, is rejected then, not when it runs.
- **`Scope.named` names the scope in a JSON thread dump** ([#1052](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1052)): the name used to be dropped. `named(null)` now throws `NullPointerException`, where it was accepted.
- **A chunk is not a `List`** ([#580](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/580)): what `chunk`, `chunkWhile` and `mapChunked` hand over prints as `NonEmptyList[1, 2]` and never equals a `List`, even one holding the same elements. Compare `chunk.toJavaList()` where code checked a chunk against a `List`.
- **A large chunk size or concurrency on a short stream returns its elements** ([#1238](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1238), [#1249](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1249)): `chunk(Integer.MAX_VALUE)` and `parEvalMap` with that concurrency used to throw `OutOfMemoryError` before reading an element. The other chunked and parallel calls, and their `VStreamPath` and `VStreamContext` forms, now return their elements too. A size that already returned chunks returns the same ones.

#### Effect Paths: lists and `StateT` {#runtime-lists-and-statet}

- **`StateT` equality leaves out the `Monad`** ([#445](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/445)): two `StateT` values wrapping the same function instance are equal, with equal hash codes, whichever `Monad` built them. `toString` prints only `runStateTFn`, so a test comparing the old text fails.
- **A list from `PathOps` or `Par` cannot be changed** ([#1017](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1017)): the `sequence` and `traverse` methods, `Par.all` and `Par.traverse` handed back their working `ArrayList`. So changing the list inside an `EitherPath` changed what every later `run()` saw. Changing one now throws `UnsupportedOperationException`, so copy it into a new `ArrayList` first.
- **`TrampolineUtils.traverseListStackSafe` and `sequenceStackSafe` return an unmodifiable list** ([#1018](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1018)): as `Traversals.traverseList` does. Changing it throws `UnsupportedOperationException`, so copy it into a new `ArrayList` first.

#### Spring {#runtime-spring}

- **The declarative HTTP client refuses an empty body for `EitherPath` and `VTaskPath`** ([#1065](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1065)): it gave `Right(null)`. It now throws an `EmptyResponseBodyException`, or fails the task, after the request has been made. A retry policy that retries every throwable would send it again, so exclude that type. Declare `Unit` where the endpoint sends no body.
- **A `Unit` success writes no body** ([#1065](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1065)): a handler that writes one value wrote `Unit` as the JSON string `"INSTANCE"`. It now sends the resolved status with no body, as a `void` controller method does.
- **A lazy Path whose step returns null writes the failure status** ([#1078](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1078)): an `IOPath`, `VTaskPath`, `CompletableFuturePath` or `FreePath` handler wrote `null` as the body. The step now fails, as a null does in any lazy computation.
- **A JSON `Either` holding `"right": null` or `"left": null` is refused** ([#1065](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1065), [#1077](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1077)): `EitherDeserializer` reports it as bad input, as `ValidatedDeserializer` does for a null value.
- **An SSE frame holding `null` fails the stream** ([#1078](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1078)): a stream from `HkjClientExchange.vstream` fails with `SseStreamException`, as for any other frame it cannot read.

#### Testing {#runtime-testing}

- **The lens and affine law harnesses check set-set in both orders** ([#1169](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1169), [#1175](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1175)). A fixture that broke set-set only in the untested order now fails. A lawful lens or affine still passes with the values either way round.
- **Lens and affine law harnesses accept one value equal to the current focus** ([#812](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/812)). Existing lawful fixtures still pass, and two equal supplied values are still rejected. A setter that ignores updates still fails set-get on the other value.
- **`assertAffineLaws` no longer requires `set` to leave an absent target alone** ([#1023](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/pull/1023)): a test that relied on it to catch an affine writing there now passes. Add `AffineLaws.assertSetNoOpWhenAbsent(affine, absentSource, value)` to keep that check.

#### Build and tooling {#runtime-build}

- **Uppercase warning settings take effect on Turkish systems** ([#1168](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1168)): remove any workaround that lowercased `WARNING` before passing it to the checker. Generated for-comprehension lambda names now use `i` rather than dotless `ı`; tuple constant names are unchanged. Numeric log counts use the root locale's digits. No source changes are required.

### What stops a build that compiled {#build-changes}

| Area | Now fails the build | Do this | Issue |
|---|---|---|---|
| Mapping | A `@GenerateMerge` fill whose pair two generic specs in this compilation both cover, where neither is more specific, which a dependency's spec for exactly the pair used to fill | Add the leaf the error spells, delegating to the spec you mean, or declare a spec for exactly the pair in this compilation | [#1123](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1123) |
| Mapping | A bean with a method that only starts like an accessor, such as `getx()` and `setx(int)` for `x`, where nothing else reads or writes the component in its place: `getaway()` beside `setAway(String)` alone, or `getid()` read through a `@ReadOnly` marker | Rename it as the error offers, such as `getX()` or `getId()`. Where it is not meant to carry the component, name its property in an `@Unmapped` marker, where the error offers one | [#1128](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1128) |
| Mapping | A PATCH bean's setter with no getter spelt `seteMail(String)`, as JavaBeans spells one for `eMail`, or `set_links(String)` | Remove the setter, or rename it after the component it should update and give it a getter, or name its property in an `@Unmapped` marker | [#1128](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1128) |
| Optics | Under a nullness checker, `FocusPaths.nullable()` assigned to an `Affine<X, X>` | Declare `Affine<@Nullable X, X>`, the type `Affines.nullable()` returns | [#767](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/767) |
| Optics | Under a nullness checker, `AtInstances.listAtWithPadding(null)` for a non-null element type | Pad with a value, or name a nullable element type: `AtInstances.<@Nullable String>listAtWithPadding(null)` | [#767](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/767) |
| Optics | `nullable()` whose result is bound to another focus type, as in `AffinePath<S, Integer> x = stringPath.nullable()`, which compiled as an unchecked cast | Convert the focus with a `Getter` or an `Iso` composed after `nullable()` | [#1017](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1017) |
| Optics | Code that holds or chains the Focus path of a field reaching a container whose `TraversableGenerator` names no optic expression, as the `AffinePath` or `TraversalPath` it widened to: its declared type, a call such as `getAll` or `via`, or a navigator method through it | Use the path the Focus method now returns, which stops at the container, and widen it with `.some(affine)` or `.each(each)`; or override `generateOpticExpression()` in the generator | [#1059](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1059) |
| Optics | A prism onto an inner class of a generic class, used at its raw type: in a type argument, as in `Prism<Outlines.Outline, Outlines.Dot> p = OutlinePrisms.dot()`, or read back as a particular `Outlines<String>.Dot` | Write `Outlines<?>.Dot` or use `var`; where the value must be an `Outlines<String>.Dot`, cast to it under `@SuppressWarnings("unchecked")`, which states the unchecked step | [#886](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/886) |
| Optics | An `@InstanceOf` target that is an inner class of a generic class, where the source does not pin an enclosing argument that the focus names, such as `Outer<String>.Plain` from a `Node<String>`, or that bounds a pinned argument, as `Z extends X` does, either of which compiled as an unchecked narrowing | Declare the focus with a wildcard there, `Outer<?>.Plain`, or narrow with `@MatchWhen` | [#886](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/886) |
| Optics | `var x = iso.andThen(traversal);` (or `traversal.andThen(affine)` or `traversal.andThen(iso)`) followed by assigning another kind of optic to `x`; your own `use(Optic)` and `use(Traversal)` overloads now pick the `Traversal` one | Declare `x` as the `Optic` you mean to hold, or call the overload you mean | [#1021](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/pull/1021) |
| Optics | A `@ViaConstructor` `parameterOrder` that passes a value where the constructor's parameter names say another belongs, such as `{"y", "x"}` for `Point(int x, int y)`, including a lens named after an accessor no parameter is named after | Write the order the error offers, which follows those names, or rebuild with the strategy it names | [#906](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/906) |
| Optics | A `@ViaConstructor` lens with no `parameterOrder`, whose `set` threw, where the constructors' parameter names give no order the call rebuilds through, a longer constructor might hold more, the lens's focus fits no constructor, or the source type is abstract | Write the order, declare the focus the error names, or rebuild with the strategy it names | [#906](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/906) |
| Optics | A spec lens whose focus is wider than its getter's wrapper, such as `Number` over an `int` getter, rebuilding through an overloaded wither, setter or constructor none of whose overloads takes the focus; setting a value of another kind used to throw `ClassCastException` | Declare the focus as the wrapper, `Integer` | [#906](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/906) |
| Optics | Under `-Werror`, a written `@ViaConstructor` `parameterOrder` that passes nothing for a value a longer constructor, or a record component, takes, such as `{"amount"}` beside `Fee(long amount, String currency)` | Write the order the warning offers, or annotate the lens method `@SuppressWarnings("shorter-constructor")` where the shorter constructor works the value out | [#1067](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1067) |
| Optics | A `@ViaConstructor` `parameterOrder` that passes a value where a variable-arity constructor's parameter names say another belongs, such as `{"note", "label"}` for `Sticker(String label, String note, String... parts)` | Write the order the error offers | [#1067](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1067) |
| Optics | Under `-Werror`, a `@ViaCopyAndSet` setter spelt as a wither whose result the lens cannot keep, such as `Shrub withTitle(String)` on a `Hedge extends Shrub`, or a fluent `withX` returning a raw or base type | Annotate the lens method `@SuppressWarnings("dropped-result")` where the method sets the copy it is called on; otherwise follow the warning's fix | [#1108](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1108) |
| Optics | A spec lens whose generated code made an unchecked conversion or call, which compiled, with javac's note on unchecked operations, unless `-Xlint:unchecked` and `-Werror` were both on: an accessor that reads a raw type for a focus with type arguments, a focus written raw for a method or constructor that takes one with them, a raw accessor passed to a `@ViaConstructor` parameter that has them, a method called through a raw builder or a raw supertype, or a focus written raw for a method that takes the type a wildcard of the source or its builder stands for | Read and rebuild through members that keep their type arguments, or declare the lens over the raw type with `@SuppressWarnings("rawtypes")` on the lens method, or declare the spec with a type argument in place of the wildcard, or point `toBuilder` at a method that hands back the builder with its type arguments, or rebuild with another strategy | [#905](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/905), [#1110](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1110) |
| Optics | With `widenCollections = true`, a Focus method over an array of a reference type, or over a container holding one, such as `String[] tags` or `List<String[]> rows`, used as its old path or chained with `.each(EachInstances.arrayEach())`. A `String @Nullable []` was an `AffinePath` to the array | Drop the `.each(EachInstances.arrayEach())` and use the path over the elements, or keep the array's own path from its lens, `FocusPath.of(SLenses.tags())`, adding `@GenerateLenses` if the record lacks it | [#1062](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1062) |
| Optics | With `widenCollections = true`, an array whose element is an SPI container, such as an `Either` or a `Map`, with a wildcard argument or none, such as `Either<?, Widget>[]` or `Either[]` | Name the element's type arguments, as in `Either<String, Widget>[]`, or drop `@GenerateFocus` and add or keep `@GenerateLenses`, as for an `Either<?, Widget>` component | [#1062](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1062) |
| Optics | A record that writes `generateNavigators = true` and holds another `@GenerateFocus` record, or a `List`, `Optional` or other container of one, that has a field named like a no-argument path method, such as `last`, `head`, `each`, `segments`, `toLens` or `toPath` | Rename that field, or keep the field that navigates into it a plain path, as the error says | [#1033](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1033), [#1103](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1103) |
| Optics | A `@GenerateFocus` `includeFields`, `excludeFields` or `widenFields` name that matches no component of the record, which changed nothing, or, as the only name in `includeFields`, left every field without a navigator | Write the component's name, as the error offers, or take the name out | [#1104](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1104) |
| Optics | Under `-Werror`, a `@GenerateFocus` field list that changes nothing: `excludeFields` beside a non-empty `includeFields`, `includeFields` or `excludeFields` with `generateNavigators = false`, `widenFields` beside `widenCollections = true`, or a `widenFields` name whose field is widened anyway or holds no container | Remove the list or the name, or the setting that leaves it unread, as the warning says | [#1104](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1104) |
| Optics | Under `-Werror`, an `includeFields` name matching a component that has no navigator, such as a `String`, an unannotated record or an unwidened `Map` of annotated records, including wildcard targets and wildcard containers | Follow the [warning's fix line](../optics/compiler_errors.md#generatefocus-includefields-no-navigator): name a navigator field, annotate the target record, widen the container, or remove `includeFields` and turn navigators off | [#1181](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1181), [#1201](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1201) |
| Optics | With `generateNavigators = true` and no `widenCollections`, a `Map` or a third-party collection of `@GenerateFocus` records, such as `ImmutableList<Position> positions`, used as the navigator over its elements: `.positions().ticker()`, `getAll`, `modifyAll`, `count`, or assigned to a `TraversalPath` | Run `MigrateDeprecationsTo0_5_0` ([Before you upgrade](#before-you-upgrade)), or add the field to `widenFields`, as the note at the field says, or set `widenCollections = true` | [#1033](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1033), [#1106](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1106) |
| Optics | A Focus method's result for a field of another `@GenerateFocus` record, or of a `List`, `Optional` or other container of one, with its type inferred: a `var` then assigned another path, such as `lines = lines.filter(p)`, or a generic call such as `Stream.of(OrderFocus.customer()).toList()` assigned to a `List<FocusPath<Order, Customer>>`. A navigator's hop into one record from a wider path, such as `orders().customer()`, is inferred the same way | Name the path type: declare the variable, or give the call its type argument | [#1033](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1033), [#1103](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1103), [#1214](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1214) |
| Optics | On a record that writes `generateNavigators = true`, two components that both reach `@GenerateFocus` records and whose names differ only in the case of their first letter, such as `items` and `Items`. A `List`, `Optional` or other container of one now gets a navigator too. Both navigator classes would be `ItemsNavigator`, so the processor refuses the later one. On the default, the later one keeps its plain path, with a note | Rename one of the components, or keep the later one a plain path, as the error's fix line says | [#1103](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1103), [#1259](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1259) |
| Optics | Code calling a lens `@ImportOptics` generated through a word, such as `draw()` through `withdraw(long)` beside `getDraw()`; a class whose only wither was such a word is now refused | Drop the call: `withdraw` never set `draw`. Where the class has a method that does set the field, name it with `@Wither` in a [spec interface](../optics/optics_spec_interfaces.md) | [#1128](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1128) |
| Optics | A call to a Focus path's `each()`, `some()`, `at(index)`, `atKey(key)`, `traverseOver(traverse)`, `head()`, `last()`, `tail()`, `init()`, `cons()`, `snoc()`, `headTail()` or `initLast()` (a `[removal]` warning) | Run `MigrateDeprecationsTo0_6_0`, or use the typed form that [Deprecated for removal in 0.6.0](#deprecated) names | [#1105](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1105) |
| Optics | A call to `Each.eachWithIndex()`, deprecated since 0.4.7, or an `@Override` of it | Declare the instance as `EachIndexed`, the type `EachInstances.listEach()` returns, and call `indexedTraversal()`, which returns the traversal itself rather than an `Optional`. For an `Each` of your own with an index, implement `EachIndexed` | [#1261](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1261) |
| Effect Paths | A `Monad` passed to `new StateT<>(fn, monad)`, `StateT.create`, `StateTKindHelper.stateT` or `StateT.mapT` | Run the recipe as [Before you upgrade](#before-you-upgrade) says, or drop the argument by hand | [#445](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/445) |

| Effect Paths | Under a nullness checker, a nullable value passed to `Either.right`, `Try.success`, `Path.right`, `Path.success`, `TryKindHelper.success`, `EitherT.right`, the `Either.Right` or `Try.Success` constructor, or `of` on `EitherMonad`, `TryMonad` or `EitherTMonad` | Pass `Unit.INSTANCE` for a step with nothing to return, or route a value that may be missing through `Maybe` | [#1065](https://github.com/higher-kinded-j/higher-kinded-j/issues/1065) |

### Deprecated for removal in 0.6.0 {#deprecated}

The `MigrateDeprecationsTo0_6_0` recipe runs each recipe the table names. See [0.6.0 deprecation migration](../tooling/openrewrite.md#060-deprecation-migration).

| Deprecated | Replacement | Recipe |
|---|---|---|
| A Focus path's `each()`, on `FocusPath`, `AffinePath`, `TraversalPath` and a navigator | `each(EachInstances.listEach())` | `ReplaceUntypedPathShortcutsRecipe` |
| A Focus path's `some()` | `some(FocusPaths.optionalSome())` | `ReplaceUntypedPathShortcutsRecipe` |
| A Focus path's `at(index)` | `via(FocusPaths.listAt(index))` | `ReplaceUntypedPathShortcutsRecipe` |
| A Focus path's `atKey(key)` | `via(FocusPaths.mapAt(key))` | `ReplaceUntypedPathShortcutsRecipe` |
| A Focus path's `traverseOver(traverse)` | `each(EachInstances.fromTraverse(traverse))` | `ReplaceUntypedPathShortcutsRecipe` |
| A Focus path's `head()`, `last()`, `tail()` and `init()` | `via(FocusPaths.listHead())`, `via(FocusPaths.listLast())`, `via(FocusPaths.listTail())` and `via(FocusPaths.listInit())` | `ReplaceUntypedPathShortcutsRecipe` |
| A Focus path's `cons()` and `headTail()` | `via(FocusPaths.listCons())` and `via(FocusPaths.listHeadTail())` | `ReplaceUntypedPathShortcutsRecipe` |
| A Focus path's `snoc()` and `initLast()` | `via(FocusPaths.listSnoc())` and `via(FocusPaths.listInitLast())` | `ReplaceUntypedPathShortcutsRecipe` |
| `ScopeJoiner.resultEither()` | `joinEither()` on the `Scope`, in place of `join()`; for a `StructuredTaskScope` you open yourself, the value its `join()` returns, or the cause of the `FailedException` it throws | By hand |
